The applicant has filed this first application under Section 439 of CrPC for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 27-01-2023 in connection with Crime No.17 of 2023 registered at Police Station Maksudangarh, District Gunafor offence under Sections 363, 376, 376(2)(n), 376(3) of IPC and Sections 5-L/6, 3/4(2) of POCSO Act.

As per prosecution story, on 23-01-2023 complainant Mahesh Mongiya along with her mother Manoj Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16319356/
1 lodged a report at Police Station Maksudangarh alleging therein that in the afternoon i.e. at around 03:00 pm, he was in the hut built at his agricultural land and his mother was in house.

sentences.text: His elder daughter aged about 14 years (prosecutrix) was also in agricultural field and he know nephew of Govind Mongia, namely, Ganga Mongiya resident of Jamner who used to driving the tractor of Govind Mongiya and on the date of incident he offered her daughter to sit on his motorcycle and saw that Ganga Mongia driving motorcycle by sitting his daughter towards Jamner.
He along with his uncle Rambabu followed him by his motorcycle but could not stop them.
It is alleged that Ganja Mongiya persuaded his daughter and took away his daughter with him on his motorcycle.
On the basis of such report, Dehati Nalishi vide 0/2023 was recorded and a missing report no. 02 of 2023 was registered on the basis of dehati nalishi.
Matter was investigated.
Crime was registered.
During investigation, prosecutrix was recovered.
On 26-01-2023, her statement was recorded in which she stated that she is aged about 14 years.
On 23-01-2023, at around 03:00 pm, she was in her house and the applicant came on his motorcycle and persuaded her to go with him.

Thereafter, she sat on motorcycle and first reached Jamner from where they went to Guna by bus and on the same day, in the night they reached by train at Jodhpur where Ganja Mongiya had already taken a room on rent and they stayed there and Ganja Mongiya forcibly committed sexual intercourse three-four times with her.

The prosecutrix in her statement also deposed that in absence of her family members they used to meet each other in the agricultural field many times and there was a physical relationship between them.
At around 02:00-03:00 pm, when they were in the room at Jodhpur, her father along with police reached there and she was rescued.
The applicant was arrested.
Thereafter, she was medically examined.
As per medical report no definite opinion regarding rape could be found by the doctor.
After completion of investigation and other formalities, charge sheet was filed.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and falsely implicated in the case.
He is in custody since 27-01-2023.
Charge-sheet has been filed and therefore, custodial interrogation of the applicant is no more required.
He undertakes to cooperate in trial.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
Hence, the applicant prayed for grant of bail.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its dismissal.
Both the Advocates are heard.
Case diary perused.

Looking to the aforesaid aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the applicant is in custody since 27-01-2023 charge sheet has been filed and conclusion of trial will take some time but without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes cash security of Rs.5,000/- along with bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of any default, cash security of Rs.5,000/- shall be forfeited without giving any notice.
CC as per rules.

(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE MKB Manoj Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16319356/
